evidence.claim: The decision-date short description identifies exactly one cohort company and exactly one panel slug.
evidence.does_not_establish: that YC itself declares the rename
evidence.establishes: a 1:1 correspondence inside the W24 batch
evidence.value: a no-code platform for automating workflows with ai
evidence.verifiable_by: grep the string in both files; each must return one entity

evidence.claim: The panel chain for gumloop is in batch winter-2024 and its earliest observation matches the decision-date team size.
evidence.does_not_establish: identity on its own; team size 2 is not distinctive
evidence.establishes: the chain is a W24 company of the right size at the right time

evidence.claim: An independent source that tracks YC cohorts lists Gumloop in YC W24 and contains no AgentHub in any cohort.
evidence.does_not_establish: the rename itself; absence of AgentHub is also consistent with the source simply not covering it. The same roster holds only 194 of our 240 W24 companies.
evidence.establishes: a third party independently places Gumloop in YC W24 and knows of no AgentHub anywhere
evidence.source: RecentFunding accelerator roster, locally cached (no network request was made by this script)

evidence.claim: A commercial private-markets database records Gumloop at gumloop.com in British Columbia, Canada - the province the 2024-03-25 spreadsheet gives for AgentHub, and NOT the San Francisco the YC page shows from the 2025-05-01 snapshot.
evidence.does_not_establish: the rename itself; Preqin's firm_othernames column is Char(1) in this WRDS load and holds no alias
evidence.establishes: an independent commercial source agrees on the domain and retains the PRE-rename geography, which a coincidental same-name company would not

preqin.amounts_omitted_reason: Preqin amount semantics are UNCONFIRMED: the WRDS table dictionary gives no description for deal_financing_size_usd or currency, both vendor glossary pages are empty, and the observed data contradicts the column name (currency CAD inside a column named _usd). No amount is recorded here.
preqin.source: Preqin Venture Capital Deals via WRDS (preqin_deals.preqindealsvc)

declaration.author: Max Brodeur-Urbas
declaration.excerpt: Up until yesterday we were known as AgentHub and used the domain AgentHub.dev. We're Gumloop now.
declaration.retrieval_note: Coordinator-supplied title/author/date/short excerpt, not a byte-for-byte page archive and not independently fetched by this script.
declaration.title: Why we rebranded to Gumloop

evidence.does_not_establish: an official YC-issued rename declaration (G1 stays OPEN); the page itself was not independently fetched or hashed by this offline script, so it is recorded as a dated citation rather than re-derived evidence
evidence.establishes: a direct first-party statement, by the company now at gumloop.com, that it was formerly named AgentHub on AgentHub.dev - unlike E1-E4 this is not derived from any file in this repository
sources: coordinator source note, 2026-11-05 (external web source; not fetched by this script and not committed as a page archive)

gaps.detail: YC's own `former_names` for `gumloop` does not list AgentHub, which is why w24_crosswalk.csv records AgentHub as UNMATCHED (method='UNMATCHED'). No file in this repository carries a YC-issued alias for this pair.
gaps.how_to_close: One HTTP request would settle it: check whether ycombinator.com/companies/agenthub redirects to /companies/gumloop. Not performed - this step was explicitly offline.
gaps.missing: An official Y Combinator rename declaration.

gaps.detail: The roster entry exists (total_raised is populated) but rf_c_gumloop.json is NOT in the local cache, so no dated round can be read offline. total_raised is a cumulative total, not a dated event, and must not be converted into one.
gaps.missing: Round-level funding detail for Gumloop from RecentFunding.

gaps.detail: The cached roster entry gives total_raised=70,600,000 with no as-of date. Gumloop's own Series A post (coordinator source note, https://www.gumloop.com/blog/gumloops-17m-series-a) states total raised to date was $20m as of 2025-01-10. The two figures are not directly comparable without the roster's as-of date and currency, and neither is converted into a dated event anywhere in this repository.
gaps.how_to_close: One API call to /companies/gumloop would return round-level detail (see G2); separately, confirm the roster's total_raised as-of date and currency before using it for anything beyond cohort placement.
gaps.missing: Reconciliation between the cached RecentFunding total_raised figure and Gumloop's own stated total.
